{{Quote|I could have killed Max &ndash; the little blue dope &ndash; and I'm a pacifist! All he had to do was look at the size of my mouth and my body to see that I don't eat much. Droopy wasn't happy, either. He eats only once a month! Jabba was going to pay us in food! But any boss worth working for pays the band and gives them a meal on top of it! I was wrong to let Max run our business affairs. After this fiasco, I vowed to leave and take Droopy with me. If that fool Rebo wants to work for food, then he should have a solo career.|[[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]]|<ref name="EGTAS" />}}
'''Max Rebo''', [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] '''Siiruulian Phantele''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] who was known as a popular musician and head member of the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]]. He was a skinny [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]], the youngest of five children.

==Biography==
[[File:Max_Rebo.jpg|thumb|left|Max Rebo playing the red ball organ.]]
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] named Siiruulian Phantele was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on his [[Species/Legends|species's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Orto/Legends|Orto]]. As he was the smallest of five [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]], [[Max Rebo's mother|his mother]] feared that he would waste away. As a consequence, Phantele spent his younger years in the pursuit of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. Eventually, he ended up working in a flanth house, where he played for his dinner every night.<ref name="who">{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}}</ref>

One day, Phantele was discovered by [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]], a crowd-pleasing [[Letaki]] [[Jizz-wailer/Legends|wailer]] who was on the lookout for a young talented yet exploitable entertainer. Orbus approached Phantele, promising him that he would never need to go hungry again, provided that he signed his musical services over. Phantele's constant pursuit of food told him that this was an opportunity not to be missed. Phantele signed himself over to Orbus, and on the recommendation of his new manager, changed his name to ''Max Rebo''. Shortly after, the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] was formed. Rebo played the [[Nalargon/Legends|red ball organ]].<ref name="who" />

[[File:TuxOrtolan.jpg|thumb|Max Rebo at Bezz Drexx's gala]]
At some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Rebo attended a VIP gala held by [[Bezz Drexx]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He found the reception boring, however, and he spent time off to the side of the crowd, with his hands in the pockets of his tuxedo.<ref name="SG">{{CWACite|7|Spy Girls}}</ref><ref name="Kaufman">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|44|CWA7: Spy Girls explained}}</ref>

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Evar Orbus was killed by Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes, because the band came to Tatooine to take their job at the Mos Eisley Cantina. This was when [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] encouraged Rebo to take lead of the musical group. Snootles, however, discreetly controlled the band herself, letting naïve Rebo take the credit as frontman. She did this in order to avoid becoming the target of those that the band might&mdash;and most likely would&mdash;potentially anger.<ref name="And the Band Played On" />

Snootles' plan had terrible repercussions for the band however, when Rebo signed the entire band over to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] with a lifelong contract including an unlimited supply of food.<ref name="And the Band Played On" />

The band was confined to performing in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], until Jabba died at the hands of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]].<ref name="And the Band Played On" /> After Jabba was killed, he went on tour with Sy since his other band member Droopy left to find his brothers in the desert. After Sy set off on her own, Rebo set out on his own solo career, and after many tours, joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to entertain soldiers.<ref name="who" />

He eventually left the music industry, and opened his own chain of restaurants: [[Max's Flangth House]]. He became quite rich, and finally settled on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="who" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The main difficulty was that it made me deaf for a few days. As I couldn't see I had to be given instructions by an earphone, but it got so tightly wedged into my ear that it affected my hearing for days after.|Simon Williamson on wearing the Max Rebo costume|<ref name="interview">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsinterviews1|url=2010/01/simon-j-williamson.html|name=Star Wars Interviews|text=Simon J. Williamson Interview &#124; Max Rebo &#124; Star Wars}}</ref>}}
Max Rebo was created for [[Richard Marquand]]'s [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="rotj" /> and first appeared in the film's [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]], released earlier in the same year.<ref name="novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'']]</ref> In the movie, he was portrayed by [[Simon Williamson]], who also puppeteered [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]] and a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], in addition to playing several [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards. In his role as Rebo, Williamson wore a costume<ref name="interview" /> from the waist up that was constructed by [[Industrial Light & Magic]].<ref name="from">''[[From Star Wars to Jedi: The Making of a Saga]]''</ref> The costume was very tight-fitting, and has prompted Williamson to count himself lucky for not being [[Wikipedia:Claustrophobia|claustrophobic]]. Unable to see, he was issued instructions via an earphone while wearing the costume.<ref name="interview" /> Two additional puppeteers helped to control the character's head and limbs.<ref name="db">{{DB|character|maxrebo|Rebo, Max}}</ref><ref name="sail barge">{{WebCite|url=http://blueharvest.net/images/barge.shtml|text=The Tatooine - Sailbarge Set|work=BlueHarvest.Net|archivedate=20171228120310}}</ref>

[[File:Simon3.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Visual effects supervisor [[Phil Tippett]] advises Simon Williamson inside of the Max Rebo costume.]]
While the visual evidence from the finished film is inconclusive, production sketches and the construction of the costume itself indicate that the limbs Max uses to play the keyboard are feet rather than hands. Max was intended to be perched on a cushion at the same height as the organ's keys, and using his sole two limbs to play the keys. Due to the way the suit was operated, with Williamson's arms performing inside the legs, the positioning of the costumes' hips contorted to Williamson's shoulders, distorting the costumes' design and the intended effect.<ref name="SWMysteries">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-mysteries-getting-to-the-bottom-of-max-rebo|series=Star Wars Mysteries|text=Getting to the Bottom of Max Rebo}}</ref> Because of this, the 1983 [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] toy took the interpretation that Max was sitting or standing inside an enclosure of his organ with the lower part of his body obscured by the instrument, and depicted him with a roughly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] body construction, with two arms and two legs. Subsequently, the 1989 [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'' continued this depiction, influencing future appearances of the Ortolan species in the Expanded Universe. Despite this error being rectified in [[canon]], several Expanded Universe interpretations of Ortolan physiology have still made their way into various pieces of media.

Since ''Return of the Jedi''{{'s}} release, Rebo has appeared in various works of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]]. He and fellow band members Sy Snootles and Droopy McCool were featured in the short story ''[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]'', included in [[1996]]'s anthology ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]'', which told of how their band came to be in Jabba's service and established them as rivals of [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]],<ref name="And the Band Played On" /> the band seen in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] in the original [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'' film]].<ref name="star wars">{{Film|IV}}</ref> ''[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]'', an article published in the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' in [[2003]], was the first source to mention Rebo's real name of Siiruulian Phantele.<ref name="who" /> The director's commentary on the [[Star Wars home video releases#Star_Wars:_Clone_Wars_-_Volume_II|DVD]] release of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' revealed that Rebo is present among a group of Ortolans seen in [[Chapter 22 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|the twenty-second episode]] of the series.<ref name="dvd">''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' [[Star Wars home video releases#Star_Wars:_Clone_Wars_-_Volume_II|DVD]]</ref>

As Rebo resembles a [[Wikipedia:Cerulean|Cerulean]] [[Wikipedia:Elephant|elephant]], it is noteworthy that "Phantele" becomes "Elephant" when the syllables are swapped, and that "Siiruulian" resembles the word "Cerulean". However, no official source has confirmed that ''Who's Who'' author [[Rich Handley]] intended this parallel. The first [[Robot Chicken: Star Wars|''Star Wars'' special]] of the American cartoon [[Wikipedia:Robot Chicken|''Robot Chicken'']] poked fun at Rebo's resemblance to an elephant, presenting every song title of the Max Rebo band as asserting that Rebo is ''not'' an elephant.<ref name="robot">''[[Robot Chicken: Star Wars]]''</ref>

A blue-skinned elephant creature named "Hooter" appears and plays a keyboard in [[Wikipedia:Michael Jackson|Michael Jackson's]] short film [[Wikipedia:Captain EO|Captain EO]]. Many fans have speculated that Rebo inspired the creature's design, and although the speculation is not confirmed, it is noteworthy that ''Star Wars'' creator [[George Lucas]] served as the executive producer of the film.<ref name="eo1">{{WebCite|url=http://www.lostepcot.com/magiceye.html|text=Magic Eye Theater (Magic Journeys and Captain EO) Pictures|work=LOST EPCOT|archivedate=20180519064903}}</ref><ref name="eo2">{{WebCite|url=http://h33t.com/details.php?id=94016cb57990bec0ae762a9e8bf6356b1d0c0788|text=Michael Jackson - Captain EO + Making Of|work=h33t|archivedate=20090214164921}}</ref><ref name="eo3">{{WebCite|url=http://www.mj-upbeat.com/RememberingDisneyWorldsCaptainEO.htm|text=Remembering Disney World's Captain EO!!|work=MJ-UPBEAT|archivedate=20110516061807}}</ref>
